properties.title: Rubymar
properties.summary:
On February 18th, Houthi militants attacked the Rubymar, a UK-owned commercial vessel traveling a critical shipping route through the Red Sea. Planet imagery from two days after the missile strike reveals the 18-mile oil slick trailing behind the damaged ship. The Rubymar finally sank on March 2nd, becoming the first vessel to be completely destroyed by a Houthi attack. A cargo load of over 21,000 metric tons of fertilizer went down with the ship, threatening an environmental catastrophe for the Red Sea’s marine ecosystems.
For more information, see this news story: https://www.reuters.com/.../freighter-rubymar-has-sunk.../
